Name: Creative Business Cup
Quick info: Creative Business Network global competition for creative-industry startups. National rounds (incl. Denmark) feed Global Finals. Prize and in-kind packages vary by year and national partner. Incorporated startups often preferred for competition rounds.

Name: EY Entrepreneur of the Year
Quick info: Prestigious annual award programme recognising outstanding Danish entrepreneurs across categories; visibility and national profile.

Name: Global Startup Awards
Quick info: International startup awards with Nordic regional rounds celebrating founders across categories and stages.

Name: Green Leap Challenge
Quick info: Food & Bio Cluster Denmark annual idea competition for green agrifood and bioresource concepts (often pre-sales). Typically 3 × DKK 50K prizes plus exposure. Watch Food & Bio Cluster news/events for the next call. Winners typically incorporate or already have CVR to receive DKK 50K.

Name: Nordic Proptech Awards 2026
Quick info: Annual awards recognising leading Nordic proptech startups and innovations in real estate technology.

Name: Nordic Women in Tech Awards
Quick info: Volunteer-run annual awards gala celebrating female role models in Nordic tech across 11 categories; conference and networking events.

Name: Odin Award
Quick info: Odense/Fyn awards (Odin, Tech, Concept, Impact) organised with Ignite Odense / Coworking Plus. Main prize historically around DKK 40K; category amounts vary. Concept targets early pre-company ideas; other categories favour established startups. Concept category targets pre-CVR ideas; Odin/Tech/Impact categories are for established startups (CVR expected).

Name: CPH Townhall
Quick info: Townhall-style Copenhagen startup community events run under Techstartup.dk (pitches, networking, ecosystem updates). Townhall is one of their recurring formats.

Name: Danmarks Entreprenørskabsfestival
Criteria: Pupils, students and educators in entrepreneurship education (primary to higher ed)
Quick info: Fonden for Entreprenørskab’s national entrepreneurship-in-education festival across six locations (primary, youth and higher education). Includes INSPIRE teacher conference, pitching finales (e.g. Projekt Edison, Start Up Programme) and prizes — primarily an education ecosystem event, not a general startup conference.

Name: Digital Tech Summit
Quick info: Major Danish tech conference connecting startups, corporates, and investors with programme tracks across digital technologies.

Name: Founder Festival
Criteria: Self-employed / sole traders / aspiring founders (Odense focus)
Quick info: One-day Founders Festival in Odense (Thrige Firkanten), organised by Ejendomsselskabet Olav de Linde and Odense Kommune. Talks, workshops and 1:1 advisor sessions for new and established self-employed founders and people considering starting.

Name: Ignite
Quick info: Odense entrepreneurship festival (Ignite Odense) with talks, networking, and award ceremonies for Funen-region startups.

Name: JoinUp North
Quick info: Annual Nordic startup gathering connecting founders, investors, and ecosystem players across the region. Cross-border networking and matchmaking — no funding attached.

Name: Nordic Fintech Week
Quick info: Annual fintech conference and networking week for Nordic fintech startups, investors, and financial institutions. Programme tracks, panels, and investor meetings across the Nordic ecosystem.

Name: Nordic Innovation Fair
Quick info: Fall innovation fair showcasing Nordic startups, research, and cross-border collaboration opportunities.

Name: Odense Investor Summit
Quick info: Annual investor–startup summit in Odense connecting Funen-region companies with angels, VCs, and corporates. Pitching and curated matchmaking for the local growth ecosystem.

Name: Seedster
Quick info: Week-long entrepreneurship bootcamp in Marbella (not a pitch competition). Mentorship, workshops, and networking; fee covers programme, catering, and hotel.

Name: SMIL
Quick info: Annual Aarhus startup festival curated by Startup Aarhus (next edition marketed as SMIL’27). Curated sessions connecting founders, investors and operators — not a cash-prize competition.

Name: Startup Aarhus Townhall
Quick info: Aarhus startup townhall events with local founder pitches, ecosystem news, and networking.

Name: Startup Lab
Quick info: Copenhagen startup community and event series offering networking, pitch opportunities, and ecosystem connections for early-stage founders.

Name: Startup Planet
Quick info: Danish startup community event series for networking, inspiration, and founder connections.

Name: TechBBQ
Quick info: Nordic's major tech conference in Copenhagen: investor meetings, side events, and startup showcase.

Name: Even Founders
Quick info: Non-profit supporting Nordic women founders via Startup School (12-week programme), investor database, co-founder matchmaking, and ecosystem partnerships. Tuborgfondet-backed.

Name: Found Diverse
Quick info: Non-profit promoting diversity in Danish entrepreneurship through events, mentoring, and community programmes (founded from NWiTA alumni network).

Name: Intech Founders
Quick info: Community and programme for female-led tech startups in Denmark with networking, mentoring, and founder support events.

Name: Kvinde kompagniet
Quick info: Danish network for female entrepreneurs offering peer community, events, and business sparring.

Name: Ladies First
Quick info: Copenhagen-based community supporting female founders with networking events, workshops, and mentorship.

Name: Next Women
Quick info: Nordic network and platform for female-led startups with events, visibility, and investor connections across the region.

Name: Nordic Female Founders
Quick info: Nordic community connecting female founders with mentors, investors, and cross-border networking opportunities.

Name: Nordic Women’s Health Hub
Quick info: Nordic Women’s Health community/hub supporting women’s health innovation and female founders with network, visibility and sector programmes across the Nordics.

Name: Time to Raise
Criteria: Founder-led startups currently fundraising or fundraising within ~6 months
Quick info: Techarena fundraising accelerator for founder-led companies (not women-only). Focuses on investor readiness, warm intros and raising capital faster; alumni report capital raised via the programme.

Name: Women in Front
Quick info: Network for Danish female leaders and entrepreneurs with events, mentorship, and leadership development.

Name: Women in Tech
Quick info: Danish community promoting women in technology through events, mentoring, role models, and career support.

Name: Akademikernes Startup
Quick info: Member benefit from Akademikernes A-kasse: 3-month Copenhagen incubator, online incubator, and on-demand courses with mentoring and networking. Open to members exploring entrepreneurship, including while on dagpenge.

Name: Beta Health
Quick info: National hospital innovation platform (Novo Nordisk Foundation). Clinicians/researchers at Danish public hospitals apply for BETA.05 (DKK 500K) or BETA.10 (DKK 1M) grants plus structured accelerator support.

Name: Beyond Beta
Criteria: DK-based startups; CVR max 7 years; MVP or customers
Quick info: EU-funded 12-month national accelerator run by Accelerace, industry clusters, and Danish Business Hubs. Tailored mentoring, workshops, and investor access. Free to join.

Name: BII Bio Studio
Criteria: Principal Investigator (prof/assoc prof, 3+ years as independent group leader); challenge-call scoped; pre-commercial project with no existing company or external investment
Funding Amount: Up to DKK 5.35M/year for up to 3 years (in-kind; convertible loan in year 3)
Quick info: Company-creation programme for academic researchers. Highly selective multi-step process (expression of interest, scientific pitch, diligence). BII encourages early dialogue on project fit before applying. Project team is hired at BII; Entrepreneur-in-Residence leads company formation (spin-out typically around year 2). Thematic calls in Human Health, Planetary Health, and related focus areas.

Name: BII Quantum Lab
Criteria: Early-stage startup HQ in NATO country; dual-use quantum technology addressing NATO DIANA challenge areas
Industrial segment: Quantum Tech, Defense Tech, Deep Tech
Quick info: 6-month programme (formerly Deep Tech Lab – Quantum), run with NATO DIANA. Supports dual-use quantum technologies with both civilian and defence applications. Access to NATO-wide defence, security, and resilience networks.

Name: BII Venture Lab
Criteria: Early-stage life science or deep tech startup; Danish CVR required for funding; prioritises Danish HQ, operations, and leadership
Quick info: 12-month accelerator maturing science and business readiness. Open-call programme for incorporated startups in Human Health, Planetary Health, and Quantum. May apply before CVR exists if a clear plan to establish a Danish entity before programme start. Eligible Danish teams may later apply for Venture House follow-on (DKK 10.5M). May apply before CVR exists if there is a clear plan to establish a Danish entity before programme start.

Name: Canute
Quick info: Scaling advisory and accelerator (now Canute by Thursday). Helps Danish founders enter US, UK, and Germany with market-entry programmes, fundraising strategy, and public-funding support. Scaling programmes assume an incorporated Danish startup.

Name: Care Tech Challenge
Criteria: DK startups 0–3 years old (CVR); limited commercial revenue on the solution
Funding Amount: No cash grant (accelerator + exposure; Danish.Care membership fee)
Quick info: Danish.Care CareTech CHALLENGE accelerator for assistive/welfare-tech startups. Activities include pitches, Investor Day, Health & Rehab exhibition, workshops and industry matchmaking. Participation requires screening plus paid Danish.Care membership (Group 1). Company age 0–3 years based on CVR.

Name: CBS CSE (Copenhagen School of Entrepreneurship)
Criteria: Students, recent graduates, or researchers at Danish higher-ed institutions; startup or committed idea stage
Quick info: CBS entrepreneurship centre (distinct from former UCPH CSE/Venture Cup). Incubator and accelerator for founders at idea through growth stage; EXPLORE pre-incubation, Deep Green Innovators, and OpenInnovation with DTU Skylab and KU Actory.

Name: Climate-KIC Urban Mobility Food
Criteria: EU-based urban mobility or food systems startups
Quick info: EIT Climate-KIC programmes for EU startups in urban mobility and sustainable food systems. Access to innovation programmes, pilots, and European cleantech networks.

Name: Defence Tech Denmark
Criteria: DK-based defense or security tech startups
Quick info: Community and support network for Danish defence and dual-use security startups, linking founders with defence stakeholders, testing opportunities, and ecosystem partners.

Name: DIF Innovation Lab
Quick info: DIF (Danish sports federation) innovation lab bridging sportstech startups with federations, clubs, athletes, and universities for user testing and scaling. SportsTech Denmark membership and government-funded innovation packages available.

Name: EESA
Quick info: Energy and sustainability accelerator/community supporting Danish cleantech startups with mentoring, industry connections, and programme activities in the green transition.

Name: Food and Bio Cluster
Quick info: Danish cluster organisation for food, bio, and agri-tech companies offering networking, internationalisation support, innovation projects, and sector-specific programmes.

Name: Founder to Leader
Quick info: Leadership development programme for Danish startup founders focusing on management skills, team building, and scaling as a CEO. Programme targets founders with an operating company.

Name: Future Manufacturers
Quick info: Manufacturing and industry 4.0 startup programme supporting Danish production-tech founders with sector expertise and scaling support.

Name: Game Hub
Criteria: DK-based gaming or interactive media startups
Quick info: Danish games industry hub offering community, events, mentoring, and business development for gaming and interactive media startups.

Name: Hub for Innovation in Tourism
Funding Amount: Programme support (accelerator; not a fixed cash grant)
Quick info: National Hub for Innovation in Tourism (HIT) — partnership of Dansk Kyst- og Naturturisme, MeetDenmark and Dansk Storbyturisme. Startup accelerator, matchmaking and network for tourism-relevant founders; co-funded by ESF+ and Danmarks Erhvervsfremmebestyrelse.

Name: Ideas Lab
Criteria: Promising startups/talent in games, film, XR, animation (Aarhus)
Quick info: Filmby Aarhus incubator / startup office (Ideas Lab) for digital creative ventures in games, film, XR and animation. Office space, mentoring, legal/accountant access, workshops and masterclasses toward acceleration — no standard cash grant.

Name: Incuba
Quick info: Danish incubator supporting early-stage tech startups with workspace, mentoring, and business development in Aalborg/North Denmark region.

Name: Leap Forward
Quick info: Tech startup growth programme offering mentoring and scaling support for Danish early-stage companies.

Name: Lighthouse Launch
Criteria: UCPH students, researchers, and postdocs with a concrete idea; KU affiliation required
Quick info: KU Lighthouse 14-week pre-accelerator for evidence-based idea validation through structured experiments. Open to students, researchers, and postdocs; replaces the former KU–Accelerace cohort pathway. Mentoring and workshops; prepares teams for POC funding, accelerators, or investment.

Name: Maritime Stars
Quick info: Maritime tech startup programme in Denmark connecting founders with shipping, offshore, and port industry partners for pilots and commercialisation.

Name: Neighborhood
Quick info: Community-driven startup hub in Copenhagen supporting local, impact-oriented founders with workspace, events, and peer network.

Name: Odense Robotics Startup Fund
Quick info: Odense Robotics cluster support for Danish robotics, automation, and drone startups including mentoring, investor access, and internationalisation via cluster programmes.

Name: Open Entrepreneurship
Criteria: Researchers at Danish universities with research-based commercialisation potential
Quick info: National collaboration across all 8 Danish universities (since 2017; now state-funded). Matches researchers with external entrepreneurs and investors via co-founder runs, investor match, and E-corps. Verticals: Deep Tech, Life Sciences, Digital, SHAPE. Gateway to Innoexplorer and spin-out pathways.

Name: PreFlight
Quick info: Nordic pre-seed programme helping very early startups validate ideas, build MVPs, and prepare for first funding rounds.

Name: Soundtech
Criteria: DK-based audio or music tech startups
Quick info: Audio and music technology incubator/community in Denmark for startups developing sound, music, and media-tech products.

Name: SPARK Denmark
Criteria: Health/life science projects with clinical or commercial potential
Funding Amount: Up to 700,000 DKK (350,000 DKK per year)
Quick info: 2×12-month structured mentoring; funds proof-of-concept studies, consultants, and prototyping only. Funds proof-of-concept work for researchers; not for established companies.

Name: STEAR
Quick info: Danish tech startup support programme offering mentoring and ecosystem access for early-stage founders.

Name: Tech Nordic
Quick info: Nordic tech startup community and support network for early-stage companies seeking cross-border connections and growth resources.

Name: The Circular Lab
Quick info: Ecoembes TheCircularLab GoCircular: European open-innovation community for circular-economy startups. Visibility via goCircular Radar, networking, challenges and GoCircularPass certification. Open to European startups (including Nordics); not a classic DK cash grant.

Name: We Build Denmark
Quick info: Construction and built-environment innovation cluster programme; annual activities for cleantech and construction startups.

Name: Lundbeck Frontier
Criteria: Academic teams working on early-stage neuroscience discoveries
Quick info: Focus: psychiatry, neurodegeneration, CNS drug discovery. Preserves publication rights and university IP ownership.

Name: NNF Distinguished Innovator Grant
Criteria: Senior Nordic researchers; proven track record
Quick info: Novo Nordisk Foundation grant for senior Nordic researchers with proven track records to pursue high-impact innovation projects. Must act as innovation ambassador within academia. Duration 3 years.

Name: NNF Pioneer Innovator Grant
Criteria: Nordic researchers; pre-CVR; health or sustainability focus
Quick info: Primarily supports early-stage research at universities and research institutes (grant to institution, not individual). Themes: cardiometabolic/infectious diseases, agriculture, food, industrial/environmental biotech, carbon capture, quantum tech. Combined annual budget DKK 190M.

Name: Open Discovery Innovation Network (ODIN)
Criteria: Precompetitive university-industry collaboration in drug discovery and diagnostics
Quick info: Results openly shared, not patented. DKK 54.5M pilot + DKK 14M from Lundbeck Foundation.

Name: Dinero Iværksætterlegat
Criteria: DK company started within last 24 months; CVR required
Quick info: Visma Dinero Iværksætterlegat: 5 × DKK 10,000 once yearly. Applicants must have started a company within the last 24 months and provide CVR plus ownership documentation. Dinero user not required. Max one A4 application page.

Name: DSV Group Innovation Partnerships
Criteria: Logistics automation, sustainability in freight, supply chain digitalisation
Quick info: In-kind access to DSV's global logistics infrastructure for pilot and partnership projects.

Name: EIC Accelerator
Industrial segment: Deep Tech, Health, Cleantech, Chemistry, Physics, Quantum Tech, Materials Science
Deadline: 6 batching dates/year (Jan, Mar, May, Jul, Sep, Nov)
Quick info: EU blended finance for single SMEs at TRL 6–8: grant up to €2.5M plus optional equity. Grant-only support available once per company under Horizon Europe.

Name: EIC Pathfinder
Industrial segment: Deep Tech, Health, Cleantech, Chemistry, Physics, Quantum Tech, Materials Science
Quick info: EU programme for ambitious early-stage research consortia pursuing breakthrough science and technology (TRL 1–4). Pathfinder Open and Challenges calls; highly competitive. Total budget EUR 262M. Open call success rate ~2.1% (2025); historically 7–8% (2021–23); Challenges strand typically higher (~10%).

Name: EIC Transition
Criteria: Must build on EIC Pathfinder, ERC PoC, or Horizon Europe Pillar II project
Industrial segment: Deep Tech, Health, Cleantech, Chemistry, Physics, Quantum Tech, Materials Science
Quick info: Predecessor project must have been active for at least 18 months before cut-off.

Name: EUDP
Quick info: Danish Energy Agency programme for industry-led consortia developing and demonstrating green energy technology (typically TRL 4–8). Co-financing ~40–60%; typical project size DKK 2–15M. 2025 funding DKK 543M.

Name: Eureka
Quick info: Pan-European network for cross-border R&D collaboration between SMEs. Danish partners can join international consortium projects with national funding through IFD/Eureka national bodies.

Name: Eurostars
Quick info: Success rate ~25–30%. IFD funds Danish participants up to EUR 500K if multiple Danish partners.

Name: GUDP
Quick info: Green Development and Demonstration Programme for food, agriculture, fisheries, and aquaculture. Supports development, demonstration, and network projects with typical grants DKK 250K–15M; ~50% co-financing.

Name: HeyFunding Legatet
Criteria: DK-based startups; focus on social impact
Quick info: Grant from HeyFunding for early-stage Danish startups with social impact focus. Supports idea validation and early development. Incorporated entity typically needed to receive and deploy grant funds.

Name: Horizon Europe
Industrial segment: Tech, Health, Biotech, Cleantech, Sustainability, Chemistry, Physics, Quantum Tech, Materials Science
Quick info: EU flagship R&D programme with rolling topic-specific calls. Danish SMEs and research institutions join collaborative consortia; national contact points and EUopSTART can support proposal preparation.

Name: IFD Grand Solutions
Industrial segment: Tech, Health, Biotech, Cleantech, Sustainability, General
Quick info: Large consortia addressing major societal challenges. Co-financing: SMEs 35–75%, large companies 25–65%, research institutions up to 90% + overhead. UCPH applicants typically supported via faculty research offices (FRB+ for SCIENCE, Nørre Alle Campus office for SUND).

Name: IFD Industrial Researcher (Industrial PhD/Postdoc)
Criteria: DK company with CVR employs candidate; university supervisor; company co-finances salary
Quick info: IFD funds company–university research hires: Industrial PhD (3 years) or Industrial Postdoc (1–3 years). Company must apply and co-finance; candidate splits time between company and university. Common spin-out route to fund a research employee while retaining academic supervision.

Name: IFD Innobooster
Criteria: Danish SMEs with CVR number; must have raised DKK 100K or have DKK 250K gross profit
Quick info: Extension of the Innofounder pathway for incorporated SMEs: co-financing for salaries, external knowledge, equipment, and materials (not rent, transport, or sales/marketing). Eligible costs: salaries, external knowledge providers, equipment, materials. Often used after Innofounder.

Name: IFD Innoexplorer
Quick info: Assessment: novelty/commercial potential, qualifications, feasibility. UCPH runs internal EoI via Lighthouse panel before full application.

Name: IFD Innofounder
Criteria: Higher-ed graduates, early startup; full-time commitment mandatory
Quick info: Non-EU/EEA applicants need Start-up Denmark visa or 1+ year in Denmark. Grant is personal income for tax. CVR required before project start. CVR required before project start; grant is personal income for tax purposes.

Name: LEO Innovation Lab
Criteria: Start-ups and academic spin-outs in dermatology, digital health, medical devices
Quick info: LEO Pharma's external innovation unit supporting digital health and dermatology startups with pilots, mentorship, and access to LEO Pharma labs and patient registries.

Name: Mikrolegat
Criteria: Students in higher ed / recent graduates (3 months) or youth/vocational (Momentum)
Funding Amount: Up to DKK 60K (higher ed); up to DKK 35K (Momentum)
Quick info: Fonden for Entreprenørskab micro-grants for student/pupil ideas. Higher-education Mikrolegat up to DKK 60K; Momentum Mikrolegat for youth/vocational students up to DKK 35K. 25% co-financing if CVR registered.

Name: Miljø- og Energi Fonden
Quick info: Private foundation funding Danish environmental and energy innovation projects with grants typically DKK 100K–5M for development and demonstration. Company CVR typically required for project implementation.

Name: MUDP
Quick info: Ministry of Environment programme co-funding development, test, and demonstration of environmental technology (pre-projects, ETV, dev/demo, and flagship projects). Typical grants DKK 1–4M with ~50% co-financing. 2025 allocation DKK 135M.

Name: Nordic Innovation
Quick info: Inter-Nordic organisation funding cross-border innovation projects between Nordic countries. Typical grants €100K–1M for collaborative SME/research partnerships.

Name: Novo Nordisk External Research and Open Innovation
Criteria: Academic spin-outs and start-ups in obesity, diabetes, cardiovascular disease, etc.
Quick info: Novo Nordisk's external innovation partnerships including option-to-licence deals on research collaborations. Deals may include upfront payments and milestones rather than traditional grant funding. Partnership deals usually require an incorporated entity.

Name: Otto Bruuns Fond
Quick info: Private foundation awarding annual grants for Danish research and innovation projects in technology and social impact. Supports development and early demonstration of new solutions.

Name: Otto Mønsteds Fond – Den Lyse Ide
Criteria: Students and educators at Danish higher-education institutions with an innovative idea
Funding Amount: DKK 500K total across winners (typically 2 prizes + bronze sculptures)
Quick info: Otto Mønsteds Fond prize Den Lyse Ide recognising innovative student/educator ideas that can contribute to Danish trade and industry. Annual call; prize package includes cash (DKK 500K shared among winners) and commissioned bronze sculptures. Broader foundation also funds other trade/industry projects via omfonden.dk.

Name: Patent og Varemærkestyrelsen
Criteria: DK-based entities; must apply for patent or trademark
Quick info: Danish Patent and Trademark Office subsidies reducing patent and trademark application costs for Danish applicants. Apply when filing IP protection.

Name: Spin-outs Denmark
Quick info: Applications require department endorsement, written application, and oral pitch. 82 grants awarded. Postdoc salary grant via university; applicants apply as researchers, not as a company.

Name: UCPH Proof of Concept Fund (POC MAX)
Industrial segment: Tech, Health, Biotech, Cleantech, Sustainability, General
Quick info: UCPH proof-of-concept fund for researchers validating commercial potential of university discoveries. Duration 12–18 months; funds must be spent within the project period. Grant to UCPH researchers; no company CVR required.

Name: UCPH Proof of Concept Fund (POC-TO-GO)
Criteria: UCPH researchers & PhD students; must have commercial or societal potential
Industrial segment: Tech, Health, Biotech, Cleantech, Sustainability, General
Quick info: Supported activities: prototype development, IP assessment, market validation, feasibility studies. Grant to UCPH researchers/PhD students; no company CVR required.

Name: Velliv Foreningen
Quick info: Annual grants from Velliv for Danish health, well-being, and social-impact projects. Supports piloting and early development of solutions that improve quality of life.

Name: Villum Foundation and VELUX Group
Criteria: Sustainable building technology, daylight research, indoor climate, biophilic design
Quick info: Joint Villum Foundation–VELUX Group programme (separate from Villum's wider grant portfolio). Collaborative research funding for sustainable building technology, daylight, indoor climate, and biophilic design. VELUX contribution qualifies as co-financing for Innobooster or EUDP.

Name: Vissing Fonden
Criteria: DK energy/climate startup with CVR; active university affiliation; university endorsement required
Quick info: Energy and climate startup grants (typically DKK 200K–300K). CVR and Danish bank account required. Energy applications are routed via partner universities — at UCPH via Lighthouse, which provides the required university endorsement before submission. Other pools (medical research, children/youth) are separate direct application tracks.

Name: Copenhagen Health Innovation (CHI)
Criteria: Students + educators matched with Region H clinics/cases
Quick info: Partnership platform (since 2016) connecting students and educators from Copenhagen-area universities/UCCs with hospitals and care organisations on real health-innovation cases. Education-driven collaboration and entrepreneurship skills — not a startup grant programme.

Name: Fonden for Entreprenørskab
Quick info: National foundation for entrepreneurship education in schools and higher education; runs programmes, teacher resources, and student entrepreneurship activities across Denmark.

Name: ITU Business Development
Quick info: IT University of Copenhagen startup programme: co-founder matching, 3-month idea pipeline, and 6-month incubation with mentorship for ITU students.

Name: NextGen Innovation (Odense Robotics)
Criteria: SMEs with robotics/drone projects in partnership with a knowledge institution
Funding Amount: Up to DKK 350K total (max DKK 200K company + DKK 150K knowledge partner)
Deadline: Per call (check Odense Robotics; Jun 2025 call closed)
Quick info: Odense Robotics / Fyn erhvervsfyrtårn development pool for robot and drone innovation. Requires min. one SME + one knowledge institution. Support is 50% of SME labour costs (de minimis) and 100% for the knowledge partner. Focus areas: large-structure production, advanced drones, autonomous near-coast shipping. Confirm current call status before applying.

Name: NOVI Legatet
Quick info: Annual student innovation grant at NOVI science park (North Jutland) supporting entrepreneurship projects by students. Helps student teams test and develop early business ideas.

Name: Novo Nordisk Foundation Fellowship Program Biomedical Design
Criteria: DK-based PhD students; biomedical design focus
Quick info: Fellowship for Danish PhD students in biomedical design; funding and structured training to translate research into health solutions.

Name: ORB
Quick info: Student entrepreneurship organisation (Odense/Aarhus region) supporting young founders with events, mentoring, and innovation activities.

Name: Start Up Factory
Quick info: Aarhus University Engineering Startup Factory — student entrepreneurship programme helping engineering students launch early-stage ventures.

Name: Startup Station
Quick info: Student innovation hub providing workspace, workshops, and mentoring for tech-oriented student founders in Denmark.

Name: Station
Quick info: Copenhagen student innovation hub (tech/design) with co-working, programmes, and community for young founders.

Name: Synapse
Quick info: Student health/biotech innovation community connecting Danish students with life science entrepreneurship programmes and mentors.

Name: UCN Next Step
Quick info: University College Nordjylland entrepreneurship programme for students developing business ideas and early ventures.
